title: Personal Credit Cards: balance transfer availability, introductory APR and fees by tier
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: balance transfer terms

This comparison table covers balance transfers on the Personal Credit Cards line: whether a tier accepts balance transfers at all, the introductory APR and how long it lasts, the window after opening within which a transfer must post to receive it, and the balance transfer fee.

## Tier table

| Card tier | Transfers accepted | Introductory APR | Introductory period (statement cycles after opening) | Window after opening for the intro APR | Fee as percent of each transfer | Minimum fee per transfer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | no | not offered | not offered | not offered | not applicable | not applicable |
| College Rewards Visa | no | not offered | not offered | not offered | not applicable | not applicable |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | yes | 0.00% | 18 months | 60 calendar days | 3.00% | 5.00 USD |
| Cash Rewards Visa | yes | 0.00% | 15 months | 60 calendar days | 3.00% | 5.00 USD |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | yes | not offered | not offered | not offered | 5.00% | 5.00 USD |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | yes | not offered | not offered | not offered | 5.00% | 5.00 USD |

## What the columns mean

- **Transfers accepted**: whether balance transfers may be made to the card.
- **Introductory APR**: the APR on balance transfers posted within the introductory window.
- **Introductory period**: the number of statement cycles after opening during which the introductory APR applies.
- **Window after opening**: the calendar days after opening within which a balance transfer must post to receive the introductory APR.
- **Fee percent and minimum fee**: the balance transfer fee as a percent of each transfer, and the minimum fee per transfer.

## Equivalent reading by tier group

- Secured Visa and College Rewards Visa accept no balance transfers, so none of the other columns applies to them.
- Platinum Low Rate Visa and Cash Rewards Visa accept transfers with an introductory APR; they differ only in the length of the introductory period.
- Travel Rewards Visa Signature and Visa Infinite Private Client accept transfers but offer no introductory APR.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Does a Travel Rewards Visa Signature transfer receive an introductory rate?**
A: No. The tier accepts transfers, but its introductory APR is not offered.
